card.name: Units right after a number
card.fires_on: The word or symbol right after a number that gives a multiple or unit, such as times, ×, kg, lb, °C or mg. It appears in dose-modification thresholds, lab limits and exposure comparisons.

modes.label: Multiples of a limit
modes.description: 'times' or '×' after a number when a lab value is compared to the upper limit of normal.
modes.example: irubin increases to >3<< times>> ULN. Permanently discontinue

modes.label: Measurement units
modes.description: A unit such as kg, lb, °C or mg right after a number in dosing, weight or storage ranges.
modes.example: ism in adults: Fondaparinux sodium 5 mg (body weight less than 50 kg), 7.5 mg (50<< kg>> to 100 kg), or

modes.label: Exposure multiples
modes.description: 'times' after a number when animal exposure is compared with human exposure.
